newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening mixed.

text.p: U.S. stocks were seen opening mixed on Monday as the market focus shifted back to interest rates and the economy and away from quarterly earnings.
This week is loaded with economic data, beginning with March new home sales Monday1400 GMT and culminating with the April employment report on Friday.

"It looks like a mixed morning. It was a bad day Friday, and nothing has changed since then," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "It will be a cautious morning. Not much is happening."
